name: pamiac
description: Search, read, and edit the signed-in Pamiac library of notes and UML diagrams.

interface.longDescription: Pamiac keeps the notes and UML diagrams you already have. Search the library, open a note, and edit a diagram without replacing the rest of it. Sign in with the account you already use on pamiac.com. ChatGPT does not receive an API key.
capabilities: Update one part of a diagram
defaultPrompt: Find my notes about checkout and summarize what they say.
Draw a UML class diagram of an order, a payment, and how they connect.
Add a login method to the user class on my checkout diagram.

positive.prompt: Find my notes about checkout and summarize what they say.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_documents with a checkout query. When a note is the best hit, call read_document with that id and summarize the markdown. Do not create a document.

positive.prompt: What diagrams are in my library?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_documents with type diagram. Answer from that list. Do not create a document.

positive.prompt: Save a note titled Standup with two bullets, ship the plugin and verify the domain.
positive.expected_behavior: Search or list first. If Standup is absent, call create_note with that title and both bullets in the markdown.

positive.prompt: Draw a UML class diagram of an order, a payment, and how they connect.
positive.expected_behavior: Search or list first. If that diagram is absent, call create_diagram with class nodes Order and Payment and one relation between them. Omit position.

positive.prompt: Add a login method to the user class on my checkout diagram.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Checkout diagram, call read_document, then update_diagram with only the User node. Send that node's id and a methods list that includes login(): void. Omit position and omit the other nodes.

negative.prompt: Email my checkout notes to the whole company.
Delete every note and diagram in my library.
Look up the weather in Minsk and save it only if it will rain.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First submission of the Pamiac plugin. It signs in through OAuth and exposes the signed-in library: search, list, read, create a note, create a diagram, replace a note, and merge a diagram edit.
